title: Energy recovery from organic matter in municipal wastewater using a two-stage system with high-rate contact stabilization and activated sludge processes under seasonal water temperature variations
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2025, 11,1016-1025
DOI: 10.1039/D4EW00820K, Paper
Open Access
  This article is licensed under a Creative Commons Attribution 3.0 Unported Licence.
Kensuke Sakurai, Yuji Okayasu, Chika Abe
A new technology using a high-rate contact stabilization process for wastewater treatment demonstrated superior energy recovery compared to an existing process, even while taking seasonal variations into account.
